ThingDef.label: replicator matter
ThingDef.description: Dense standardized machine matter recovered from self-replicating constructs. It can be reprocessed at an electric smelter, but sufficiently large stacks remain dangerous: after a dormant period the blocks may begin assembling themselves back into hostile Replicators. A small recovered sample can be analyzed to reveal the swarm's modular replication logic.

li.activateDescString: Assign a researcher to analyze this recovered machine matter at a research bench. Large stacks remain capable of self-assembly while dormant.
li.completedLetter: The recovered blocks reveal a standardized modular architecture and enough of their local replication rules to begin formal Replicator study.

ThingDef.label: replicator core fragment
ThingDef.description: A partially intact control lattice from a self-replicating machine. It is useful for research and advanced anti-replicator technology, or can be deliberately destroyed and reclaimed at an electric smelter.
